Recorded verbatim in the checker header comment.

defectsFoundAndFixedDuringImplementation: Naive quote tracking: an apostrophe inside a packer COMMENT (the extension wave s QA lane) was read as a string opener, so the scan ran past the array literal and reported 37 phantom entries (LICENSE, dist, utf8, ...). The positive-control arm caught it immediately (exit 1 on a healthy tree). Fixed with a real mini-lexer that consumes // comments and single/backtick strings as units.
A blanket pre-strip of // comments was rejected as the fix because it would truncate the real regex literal on pack-mpd.mjs:16; the lexer never rewrites string or regex bodies.

The templates static assertion was first written in a mandatory-slash form, which MISSED the realistic spelling join(repoRoot, "templates", "mpd-extension") - the quoted segment there is just the word templates with no slash. Arm 6, added for exactly this, failed and exposed the gap; the regex now accepts the bare quoted segment, a leading prefix, and a trailing suffix.

After that fix, arm 6 s own predicate (which still required the old literal) failed and the self-test went RED - the falsifier caught the diagnostic drift too; the predicate now asserts the TEMPLATES kind plus the word templates in the output.
